name: Does new garage door trim include weatherstripping?

mainEntity.name: Does new garage door trim include weatherstripping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, garage trim installation should include integrated weatherstripping or a dedicated vinyl seal flap. Most exterior garage door jamb trim is fitted with a flexible vinyl weatherstrip edge that presses gently against the closed garage door. This seal keeps out cold wind, driving rain, dust, and insects. A finish carpenter ensures the trim is mounted at the exact depth needed so the seal sits flush without binding against the moving garage door panels or stressing the automatic opener mechanism.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, exterior garage door casing typically includes or accommodates a flexible vinyl weatherstrip flap that seals the gap between the door panels and the jamb.
